Package com.codereviewagent.api.controller

Class RuleController

java.lang.Object
com.codereviewagent.api.controller.RuleController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1") public class RuleController extends Object
Maps CRUD operations for user-owned rules and rule sets.
